metadata.question: Does the number of fire hotspots in the Paraná River delta from January through July 22, 2020, exceed those detected during the same period in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) dataset in GEE: "FIRMS" collection - Most reliable: MODIS active fire product (MOD14A1/MYD14A1) or VIIRS - Best option: ee.ImageCollection("FIRMS") or MODIS/VIIRS collections - Actually, the best dataset is: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or "MODIS/061/MOD14A1" for daily fire data - Even better: Use the vector dataset "FIRMS" which is point-based fire detections - Best approach: Use ee.FeatureCollection for FIRMS data or count fire pixels from thermal anomaly bands 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire detection - We need to count fire hotspots/pixels - Use confidence levels to filter quality detections 3. Logic: - Compare fire counts between 2019 (Jan 1 - July 22) vs 2020 (same period) - Valid zero means no fires detected (legitimate) - C1: No data available - C2: Not applicable (fire data doesn't need masking like clouds) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: 2020 > 2019 - B: 2020 <= 2019 Let me use MODIS thermal anomaly data or FIRMS point data for counting fire hotspots. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Paraná River delta region (Argentina) const parana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-60.8, -34.5], [-60.8, -32.5], [-58.0, -32.5], [-58.0, -34.5], [-60.8, -34.5]] ]); // Date ranges const start2019 = '2019-01-01'; const end2019 = '2019-07-22'; const start2020 = '2020-01-01'; const end2020 = '2020-07-22'; // Use MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire Daily product const fires2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(start2019, end2019) .filterBounds(parana) .select('MaxFRP'); // Maximum Fire Radiative Power const fires2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(start2020, end2020) .filterBounds(parana) .select('MaxFRP'); // Check if collections have data const size2019 = fires2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = fires2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both periods'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Count fire pixels (MaxFRP > 0 indicates fire detection) const countFires = function(collection) { const composite = collection.max(); // Get maximum FRP across all dates const firePixels = composite.gt(0); // Pixels with fire detection const stats = firePixels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: parana, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats.get('MaxFRP'); }; // Calculate fire hotspot counts const count2019 = countFires(fires2019).getInfo(); const count2020 = countFires(fires2020).getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Fire Hotspots: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 Fire Hotspots: ${count2020}`); // Validate results if (count2019 === null || count2020 === null || isNaN(count2019) || isNaN(count2020)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare fire counts if (count2020 > count2019) { console.log(`2020 exceeds 2019: ${count2020} > ${count2019}`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`2020 does not exceed 2019: ${count2020} <= ${count2019}`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
